items.action: Obtain the actual copyright/permission notices from their rights holders and include them in the distributed notices. Installed packages and their npm gitHead source trees declare ISC/MIT but do not contain the full original license notices. Do not invent copyright years or a grant from metadata alone.

items.scope: Code, documentation, logos, screenshots and workshop media
items.action: Maintainer must document publication rights, employment/client clearance where applicable, and uncertain third-party or AI-assisted material. Attach the statement and supporting evidence; do not infer ownership from the MIT license.

Obtain a redistribution grant covering the SDK/runtime included in FDO, or remove those components from distribution. The installed license reserves rights and refers to Cursor terms; npm availability does not establish redistribution permission.

items.scope: Dugite native v2.53.0-4: Git, Git LFS, Git Credential Manager and platform libraries/tools
items.action: Audit each target archive, include its component notices, and fulfill applicable GPL corresponding-source obligations for the exact shipped binaries, including required build scripts/patches. An upstream source link alone is not recorded as fulfillment. Store the actual source distribution or a reviewed compliant alternative with release evidence.

items.scope: Native Codex, Cursor and TypeScript-Go embedded dependencies
items.action: Obtain version/platform-specific embedded dependency notices and review source/redistribution obligations. Parent npm metadata is not a complete inventory of Rust, Go, .NET or other native dependencies. Codex upstream LICENSE and NOTICE are now retained, but do not establish complete native coverage.

items.scope: vscode-icons artwork, highlight.js custom build and copied stylesheets
items.action: Review branded-icon permissions and ShareAlike attribution/source obligations; identify file_type_npm.svg origin or replace it with a cleared asset. Record the highlight.js custom build recipe and stylesheet origins. Recheck third_party/assets.json after any replacement.
